$comment: Label taxonomy for audio-lab. Convention: 'namespace: value' with a space. The type/area/priority axes follow the github-portfolio-modernization 'goldilocks' set — type and priority are carried verbatim because they are genuinely portable; area values are repo-specific and describe this project's domains. The nine GitHub stock labels below (bug/documentation/enhancement/duplicate/good first issue/help wanted/invalid/question/wontfix) are RETAINED by maintainer decision 2026-07-26 (issue #21): all were unused (0 issues/0 PRs) but kept rather than deleted, so they are declared here to keep this file identical to the live label set. This file is the source of truth; scripts/sync_labels.py syncs it to GitHub and checks for drift. The sync is additive — it never deletes a live label — so a label present live but absent here is reported as drift, not removed. Do not create labels outside this file.

labels.name: type: bug
labels.description: Something in the tooling or automation is broken

labels.name: skip-changelog
labels.description: Exempt from the changelog gate — use sparingly

labels.name: duplicate
labels.description: This issue or pull request already exists

labels.name: wontfix
labels.description: This will not be worked on
